packages.title: Blitzer alerts
packages.summary: Warn about speed cameras from blitzer.de while driving, with a status panel and a declarative map-overlay card.

manifest.title: Blitzer alerts
manifest.summary: Warn about speed cameras from blitzer.de while driving, with a status panel and a declarative map-overlay card.

settings.title: Blitzer alerts
settings.summary: Poll the public blitzer.de marker API while driving.

settings.title: Update interval
settings.summary: Seconds between marker requests. The public API is polled no faster than every 30 seconds.

settings.title: Search radius
settings.summary: Radius of the marker request around the current position.

packages.title: ISA by driver profile
packages.summary: Mute the ISA speed warning for selected driver profiles. Profiles are discovered on each vehicle; none are selected initially.

manifest.title: ISA by driver profile
manifest.summary: Mute the ISA speed warning for selected driver profiles. Profiles are discovered on each vehicle; none are selected initially.

settings.title: Muted driver profiles
settings.summary: Profile keys whose ISA speed warning is muted. Change this from the package panel.

packages.title: Wiper low beam
packages.summary: Switch the low beam on after 30 s of wiper activity and release it after 30 s of rest.

manifest.title: Wiper low beam
manifest.summary: Switch the low beam on after 30 s of wiper activity and release it after 30 s of rest.

settings.title: Low beam after 30 s of wipers
settings.summary: Switch the low beam on after 30 s of wiper activity.
